column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/event_given_out_values.onsa tests=5 evaluated=5 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ one event a tick, with work of its own below the part that gives it: the event comes back to the input of the flow after that work
@ two events a tick of the flow: the two are ticked after both runs
@ the same written out: each event is ticked after its run, and the next run sees it
@ two events a tick and a reset_if~ of the flow by its own events: the reset is after both runs
@ the same written out: the reset is after the run that gave the event, before the next run
